form.official-title: To amend the Financial Stability Act of 2010 to require covered financial institutions to include elements of accumulated other comprehensive income when calculating capital for purposes of meeting capital requirements, and for other purposes.

section.text: This Act may be cited as the Bank Safety Act of 2024.

section.header: Capital requirements relating to accumulated other comprehensive income

subsection.text: Section 171 of the Financial Stability Act of 2010 (12 U.S.C. 5371) is amended by adding at the end the following new subsection:

subsection.header: Inclusion of elements of accumulated other comprehensive income

paragraph.text: The computation of capital for purposes of meeting capital requirements for a covered financial institution shall include AOCI.

clause.text: all accumulated other comprehensive income components, except for accumulated net gains and losses on cash flow hedges related to items that are not recognized at fair value; or
such other definition as the Federal banking agencies may establish, by rule.
The term covered financial institution means—

subclause.text: a depository institution holding company (as defined in section 3 of the Federal Deposit Insurance Act) with total consolidated assets greater than $100,000,000,000;
an insured depository institution over which a bank holding company does not have control with total consolidated assets greater than $100,000,000,000; or

such other category of depository institution holding companies or insured depository institutions as may be jointly determined by the Federal banking agencies, by rule, based on an analysis of financial risk-related factors.

clause.text: Unless the Board of Governors determines it to be necessary to ensure the safety and soundness of a covered financial institution, the term covered financial institution does not include a savings and loan holding company—

subclause.text: that is substantially engaged in insurance underwriting or commercial activities; or
with respect to which the Small Bank Holding Company and Savings and Loan Holding Company Policy Statement of the Board of Governors applies (12 CFR 225 app. C).

paragraph.text: The Federal banking agencies shall, jointly, establish a transition period for the application of the requirement under subsection (d) of section 171 of the Financial Stability Act of 2010 to a covered financial institution (including an opt out institution) that—

subparagraph.text: phases in such requirement over time; and
fully applies such requirement to covered financial institutions on or before July 1, 2028.
The term covered financial institution has the meaning given that term under section 171(d) of the Financial Stability Act of 2010.
The term Federal banking agency has the meaning given that term under section 3 of the Federal Deposit Insurance Act (12 U.S.C. 1813).

The term opt out institution means a covered financial institution that elected to opt out of the requirement to report accumulated other comprehensive income components pursuant to the rule titled Changes to Applicability Thresholds for Regulatory Capital and Liquidity Requirements (84 Fed. Reg. 59230; November 1, 2019).
